title_original: REVIT 2026 Won't export to IFC?
question_paraphrase: Revit 2026 refuses to export IFC and shows an unable-to-write style error when targeting a mapped network drive; saving to the desktop works.
phrasing_notes: Short all-caps-ish title with question mark; symptom only, little diagnostics.
answer_summary: Export to a local folder like C:\Temp, run Revit as administrator, and disable the duplicate IFC exporter add-in (built-in vs standalone) via Add-Ins manager.

title_original: IFC export from RVT2026 and linking problem
question_paraphrase: Exported IFC from Revit 2026 and linked it back into the same model: the building lands at the right absolute level but the Revit levels come out at about twice the elevation. Changing the coordination base did not give the needed absolute coordinates.
context_given: Project Base Point / Survey Point export base
phrasing_notes: Describes the symptom with numbers (RL vs level height), mentions what was already tried.
answer_summary: No confirmed fix; related threads suggest consistent level Elevation Base, origin-to-origin placement then Acquire Coordinates, or a second local-coordinate IFC.

title_original: REVIT 2026 : Export PDF quality with linked IFC models
question_paraphrase: PDF export from Revit 2026 gives poor print quality on sheets that contain linked IFC models.
phrasing_notes: Capitalised product name and colon in title; vague symptom.

title_original: Unable to create IFC
question_paraphrase: Structure user cannot create an IFC from Revit 2026, export stops with a cannot-write error on a network path.
phrasing_notes: Very terse title, no version in title.
answer_summary: Try a plain local folder and a different file name; if that works it is permissions or file locking; run as admin if no extra exporter installed.

title_original: Issues exporting IFC4x3 / "Unexpected errors occurred while exporting these elements to the IFC file...
question_paraphrase: Exporting to IFC4x3 from Revit 2025 raises 'Unexpected errors occurred while exporting these elements' for certain door families.
phrasing_notes: Quotes the exact error dialog text in the title.
answer_summary: Autodesk support replied it was already corrected in Revit 2026; use 2026 for IFC4x3 export.

title_original: Issues with exporting type parameters from Revit to IFC
question_paraphrase: Instance parameters reach the IFC property sets but type parameters are missing in the exported file.
phrasing_notes: Plain wording, 'Issues with' opener, marked Solved.
answer_summary: Enable the export option that allows type properties in instance property sets.

title_original: IFC Export location issue
question_paraphrase: After IFC export the model sits in the wrong place in the receiving application; the receiver seems to apply the survey point offset again.
phrasing_notes: Calls it a 'location issue'; asks for a setting rather than describing numbers.
answer_summary: Adjust the import positioning setting in the receiving software or export a second IFC in local coordinates.

title_original: Revit 2026: IFC Link Binding Issue
question_paraphrase: Bind Link on a linked IFC in Revit 2026 produces an empty model group and distorted geometry.
phrasing_notes: Version prefix with colon in title, then feature name.
answer_summary: User bound in Revit 2022 then brought the RVT into 2026; reply notes the template chosen at link time can cause misplaced geometry.

title_original: Linked IFC Model Not Appearing in Revit PDF Exports
question_paraphrase: A linked IFC shows in the view but disappears when the sheet is exported to PDF.
phrasing_notes: Title-case title, solved flag.
answer_summary: Enable 'Replace halftone with thin lines' in the PDF export options.

title_original: Revit IFC4x3 export incorrect space boundaries
question_paraphrase: IFC4x3 export from Revit 2025 loses second-level space boundaries while IFC4 Reference View is correct.
phrasing_notes: Technical title naming the entity-level problem; compares two MVDs.
answer_summary: Attributed to the IFC4x3 exporter implementation; install the newer exporter from Autodesk GitHub and prefer IFC4 Reference View for now.

title_original: REVIT TO IFC EXPORTING AND MAPPING TASKS
question_paraphrase: User asks how to handle the tasks of exporting to IFC and mapping Revit parameters/categories to IFC.
phrasing_notes: All-caps title, broad 'tasks' framing typical of newcomers.

title_original: IFC link takes long and Revit crashes
question_paraphrase: Linking an IFC takes very long and Revit crashes; Task Manager shows no busy process at crash time.
phrasing_notes: Plain symptom title, marked Solved.
answer_summary: Revit converts the IFC to RVT while linking so memory matters; use Open IFC first then link the RVT, simplify dense families, split the IFC, or go via Navisworks.

title_original: Revit 2025.4.4 Crashes Immediately When Clicking ANY "Import" or "Link" Command
question_paraphrase: After the 2025.4.4 update Revit hits a fatal error as soon as any Insert-tab Import/Link command, including Link IFC, is clicked.
phrasing_notes: Capitalised ANY for emphasis; version-patch number in title.

title_original: Problem linking IFC in Revit (ACC / Desktop Connector issue)
question_paraphrase: Linking an IFC stored in ACC through Desktop Connector stalls with queued upload and queued deletion; the ACC rename to Forma seems to have broken older IFC links.
phrasing_notes: Parenthetical product names in title.
answer_summary: One user fixed it by uninstalling the connector, clearing cache and Docs folder, and installing the current connector version.

title_original: IFC export: User Defined Property Sets
question_paraphrase: Asks how to get user-defined property sets to export reliably from Revit.
phrasing_notes: Short colon-style title.

title_original: IFC custom property NOT EXPORTING
question_paraphrase: Custom properties from a user-defined property set text file do not show in the exported IFC in Revit 2025.
phrasing_notes: NOT in capitals, no detail in title.
answer_summary: Poster resolved it by uninstalling the Revit IFC 2025 plug-in; the cause was not identified.

title_original: Missing properties when exporting IFC from Revit using custom property set mapping TXT file
question_paraphrase: Some mapped properties are absent from the IFC although the TXT property-set file looks right.
phrasing_notes: Long descriptive title naming the TXT method.
answer_summary: Check unit/data-type mismatch against the IFC schema property of the same name (use a differently named Revit parameter), and make sure values are not empty.

title_original: Ifc export in 2027 - mapping parameters severely lacking
question_paraphrase: The new IFC mapping dialog in Revit 2027 lists only some parameters: IfcBeam shows none, IfcPile shows only Generic Model parameters, and project parameters cannot be mapped; Phasing no longer reaches Pset_Common.
phrasing_notes: Strong evaluative wording ('severely lacking'), compares with 2022-2025 behaviour.
answer_summary: Autodesk acknowledged empty property lists as a known issue with a fix planned; the PSet.txt route still works for user-defined sets.

title_original: GUI for Project Parameter Mapping in IFC Export Missing in Revit 2027
question_paraphrase: Asks for the new GUI to include project, shared and family parameters so custom property sets can be built without TXT files.
phrasing_notes: Idea-board style title: 'GUI for X Missing'.

title_original: IFC Exports in Revit: missing Shared Parameters with Key Schedules
question_paraphrase: Shared parameters driven through key schedules are not written into the IFC property sets.
phrasing_notes: Colon-led title with product prefix.

title_original: Multiple buildings in one Revit Project; IFC export issues; Possible Improvement Discussion.
question_paraphrase: A project holding several buildings has trouble exporting IFC with the right IfcBuilding/storey structure; the poster invites discussion of improvements.
phrasing_notes: Semicolon-separated three-part title, discussion tone.

title_original: Structural connections IFC parameters
question_paraphrase: Needs Psets and shared parameters of steel connections in IFC.
phrasing_notes: Noun-phrase title.
answer_summary: Autodesk support reportedly confirmed Psets and shared parameters cannot be exported for structural connections.

title_original: IfcGUIDs of linked project files
question_paraphrase: When linked Revit files are combined into one IFC the IfcGUIDs do not match those from separate exports.
phrasing_notes: Noun-phrase title with exact entity name.

title_original: Revit 2024.3 Update - Revit crashes every time I export IFC!!!
question_paraphrase: After the 2024.3 update Revit crashes on every IFC export.
phrasing_notes: Triple exclamation marks, update number in title, urgent tone.
answer_summary: A third-party add-in (IFC model exchange add-in for another BIM tool) broke export; deleting its .addin file fixed it.

title_original: Linked IFC with almost every project element set to Generic models
question_paraphrase: Linked IFC elements all arrive in Revit as Generic Models.
phrasing_notes: Plain description, marked Solved.
answer_summary: Mapping file was corrupted or re-saved; change the mapping .txt encoding to UTF-8.

title_original: Ifc export ducts and pipes
question_paraphrase: Ducts and pipes export as IfcFlowSegment instead of IfcDuctSegment/IfcPipeSegment.
phrasing_notes: Lowercase 'Ifc', plain title.
answer_summary: IfcDuctSegment/IfcPipeSegment exist only in IFC4+; in 2x3 you must read the Pset names; use IfcExportAs shared parameter or Dynamo for bulk assignment.

title_original: PR: IFC export ignores mapping table setting for certain built-in parameters
question_paraphrase: Shared parameters named like built-ins (Volume/Area in a local language) are overwritten by the built-in values in the IFC, however the TXT mapping is configured.
phrasing_notes: Structured bug template; notes case-insensitive name clash.
answer_summary: Logged internally by Autodesk as an open bug (REVIT-255184).

title_original: INQ: RVT 2027 - New Manage Property Dialog
question_paraphrase: In the new Manage Default Property Sets dialog of Revit 2027 not all Revit parameters appear in the Revit Property column; changing data type to Length shows none; asks what Property Type Single/Bounded/List/Table means and cannot find it in the Help.
phrasing_notes: Polite 'Hello everyone', several numbered questions.
answer_summary: Autodesk explained the picker only lists parameters on categories mapped to the IFC entity and matching the data type; logged as REVIT-254494.

title_original: INQ: Revit 2027: How to add a user defined property set to a project?
question_paraphrase: In 2027 the property-set entity selection list lacks IfcProject, which was available before for user-defined psets.
phrasing_notes: One-line complaint plus screenshot.
answer_summary: Fixed in exporter 27.3.0.12 release notes (adding a user-defined property set to a project).

title_original: PR: Revit 2026 IFC structural export: predefined types not exported (ifcbeam and ifc column)
question_paraphrase: After the latest Revit update structural beams and columns with a predefined type are not exported at all, on every IFC version tried; no option to revert once predefined type is set.
phrasing_notes: Describes regression timing ('started with latest update').
answer_summary: Autodesk QA could not reproduce and asked for a sample file.

title_original: PR: Joins between elements not exported correctly in Revit 2026
question_paraphrase: Wall joins export wrongly in IFC from add-in 26.1.0 and 26.4.1 but worked in Revit 2025 with exporter 25.4.40; screenshots compare Revit, 2026 and 2025 results.
phrasing_notes: Regression framing with before/after versions.
answer_summary: Autodesk root-caused it (wall join extending beyond its nominal extrusion profile was clipped) and merged a fix into the 2027.3 line without backport yet.

title_original: INQ: How to export Revit Category as Revit user defined property set?
question_paraphrase: Built-in 'Export Revit property sets' includes Category but no variant of Category/Revit Category/Category Id/Category Name works in a user-defined PSet TXT file, while Family and Type do.
phrasing_notes: Pastes the TXT file with comments marking what works.
answer_summary: Open as REVIT-248491; a later commenter says only Dynamo works around it.

title_original: INQ: Exporting parameters with empty values
question_paraphrase: Wants Revit to export parameters even with empty values, ideally as null, so the IFC is prepared for validation and later editing.
phrasing_notes: Polite, brief, asks for a switch in IFC settings.
answer_summary: Autodesk: empty parameters are not exported by design, no option exists today; asked for use case.

title_original: PR: IFC4x3 Reference View export writes CoordinationView in FILE_DESCRIPTION
question_paraphrase: IFC4x3 Reference View export from Revit 2026 declares ViewDefinition [CoordinationView] in the header instead of ReferenceView; FILE_SCHEMA is IFC4X3_ADD2.
phrasing_notes: Pastes the exact header lines.
answer_summary: Reproduced by Autodesk as REVIT-258390, fixed in Revit 2027; header can be edited manually meanwhile.

title_original: PR: Problem with Z coordinate when using "Link IFC"
question_paraphrase: In Revit 2025-2027 Link IFC places the building too high and creates levels at twice the correct elevation; Open IFC and Revit 2023/2024 map Z to the Project Base Point correctly.
phrasing_notes: Compares versions and Link vs Open IFC.
answer_summary: Autodesk tracks a duplicated Z offset in the Link IFC path (REVIT-237045).

title_original: PR: Link IFC fail
question_paraphrase: A one-chair family exports fine and opens in BIM Vision but Revit cannot link it back; Link IFC hangs until the process is killed.
phrasing_notes: Minimal repro, mentions other viewer works.
answer_summary: Autodesk reproduced it; Open IFC works (REVIT-249806).

title_original: PR: There has been an unrecoverable error during export. Try using filters and "Current View Only" mode...
question_paraphrase: IFC exporter 26.4.0 and 26.4.1 abort with the unrecoverable-error message on a workshared model uploaded to Autodesk Forma; 26.1.0 works and the same error was seen in Revit 2025.
phrasing_notes: Quotes the full error text as the title.

title_original: PR: Room geometry shifted in IFC Exporter 25.4.40.17 + 25.4.41.5 + 26.4.0.16 + 26.4.0.32
question_paraphrase: IfcSpace geometry is wrong in several models: some spaces moved outside the building and changed shape, red (older exporter) vs blue (newer) comparison.
phrasing_notes: Lists exact build numbers; image comparison.
answer_summary: Fixed in 27.0.1.1 per release notes (GitHub #924); Autodesk requested sample files.

title_original: PR: Setting Classes / Predefined types in export
question_paraphrase: Most categories are mapped to IfcBuildingElementProxy.NOTDEFINED but Ceiling, Curtain Wall, Sloped Glazing, Structural Column and Framing always export as fixed classes; forcing via Export to IFC As, IFC Predefined Type and type variants made it worse.
phrasing_notes: Itemised list of what was tried.
answer_summary: Open bug REVIT-244556.

title_original: ENH: IDS auditing

phrasing_notes: Self-aware preface ('maybe completely out of scope'); enthusiastic about IDS.
answer_summary: Autodesk asked how much IDS is used; another user said IDS is growing in Germany but forces N/A values that bloat files, and wants parameter mapping fixed first.

title_original: PR: Export to network folder permission problem
question_paraphrase: Export to an SMB share is blocked with a no-write-access message although the user can write in Explorer; local paths work; worked in Revit 2025 and earlier.
phrasing_notes: Expected vs Actual structure; diagnoses the SID comparison in code.
answer_summary: Open as REVIT-252369; fixed in exporter 27.3.0.12 release notes.

title_original: PR: Link / Import IFC 4x3 Revit 2024
question_paraphrase: Revit 2024.3 cannot link IFC4x3 files declaring schema IFC4X3_ADD2; editing the header to IFC4X3 makes it link.
phrasing_notes: Gives the header workaround.
answer_summary: Tracked as REVIT-245211.

title_original: PR: 2D symbol/annotation causes doors and windows to be incorrectly positioned in the wall.
question_paraphrase: IFC from Archicad with 2D annotation symbols places doors and windows wrongly in the wall in Revit 2025-2027 but not in 2024; IFC2x3 and IFC4 test files attached.
phrasing_notes: Version range comparison; attaches test files.
answer_summary: Autodesk separated it from a related 3D hosted-door issue and tracks both.

title_original: PR: Yes/No parameter named only "AboveGround" is not exported (IfcLogical), but "Pset_BuildingStoreyCommon.AboveGround" works
question_paraphrase: A Yes/No level parameter intended for Pset_BuildingStoreyCommon.AboveGround only exports when named with the full Pset.Property form; IfcBoolean EntranceLevel works with the short name.
phrasing_notes: Very long structured write-up ('What I am trying to do / what works').

title_original: PR: Parameter expression not evaluated when referenced parameter is empty (Walls and Doors)
question_paraphrase: Using {$this("ParameterName")} expressions in built-in psets (FireRating, AcousticRating) sometimes writes the literal expression text into the IFC when the referenced parameter is empty.
phrasing_notes: Summary-style bug write-up.
answer_summary: Open as REVIT-256305.

title_original: PR: Psets with IFCElement are not exported, exports only as IFCRoot
question_paraphrase: A user-defined pset declared for IFCElement exported nothing in Revit 2022-2025; changing the target to IFCRoot fixed it.
phrasing_notes: Shares the workaround found rather than asking.
answer_summary: Autodesk could not reproduce with IFCElement in 2023-2026 and asked for files.

title_original: IFC for Revit exporter release notes 27.4.0.30 / 27.3.0.12 / 25.4.40 (Autodesk/revit-ifc releases)
question_paraphrase: Release notes list IFC4.3 Reference View exchange requirements added in 25.4.40 and 24.3.40, property-mapping fixes in 27.x, and extended properties moved from the 'Other' pset into a pset named after the element.
phrasing_notes: Terse changelog bullets.
answer_summary: Use as the reference for which exporter build fixes which problem.

title_original: IFC Parameter Mapping (Revit What's New)
question_paraphrase: Official What's New: map parameters to IFC property sets in the Export IFC setup (Modify Setup), pick a Property Mapping configuration, and create/import/export mapping configurations without editing TXT files.
phrasing_notes: Marketing-style official text.
answer_summary: Describes the new GUI workflow that replaces TXT editing.

prompt: how many IfcBuildingElementProxy in this ifc and which revit categories did they come from? need to fix the mapping before friday
expected_behavior: Count IfcBuildingElementProxy, group by Revit category / ObjectType / Reference property, list top categories, suggest category or IfcExportAs mapping fixes.

prompt: type params are missing from the walls psets in this export, instance ones are there. can you check which walls have Pset_WallCommon but no type-level props
expected_behavior: List walls, compare instance vs type property sets, report elements lacking type properties, and recommend enabling 'type properties in instance property sets' in the export setup.

prompt: check every IfcWall has Pset_WallCommon.FireRating filled, not empty and not a literal text like {$this(...)}. give me a list of the bad ones
expected_behavior: Iterate IfcWall, read FireRating, flag missing/empty values and values containing '{$this(' expression text, return GlobalId/Name/Level for each.

prompt: linked this ifc back into revit and the levels are at double the height. what are the storey elevations in the ifc and what's the IfcSite elevation / map conversion
expected_behavior: Read IfcBuildingStorey.Elevation, IfcSite RefElevation, IfcMapConversion/ProjectedCRS and placements; explain probable double-offset (Project Base Point vs Survey Point) and give numbers.

prompt: whats the schema and view definition in the header of this file? it says ifc4x3 reference view but I think its coordinationview
expected_behavior: Read FILE_SCHEMA and FILE_DESCRIPTION; report schema (IFC4X3_ADD2) and ViewDefinition; note the known 2026 exporter bug writing CoordinationView for Reference View.

prompt: list all IfcSpace with their Qto_SpaceBaseQuantities (NetFloorArea, GrossPerimeter) and flag the ones with zero or no quantities
expected_behavior: Collect IfcSpace, read Qto_SpaceBaseQuantities, output table, flag missing/zero values, mention room-in-view and 3D-view export pitfalls.

prompt: compare the ifc from revit 2025 export and the 2026 one, walls at joins look different. which walls changed geometry or guid?
expected_behavior: Match elements by GlobalId, diff counts and representations/bounding boxes, report walls with changed geometry and GUID mismatches, and caveat exporter-version join behavior.

prompt: all my beams and columns lost their predefined type in this ifc. how many IfcBeam / IfcColumn have NOTDEFINED vs real PredefinedType
expected_behavior: Count IfcBeam/IfcColumn by PredefinedType, highlight NOTDEFINED/missing, compare with Revit type data if provided.

prompt: ducts and pipes are all IfcFlowSegment, can you tell which are ducts vs pipes from the psets and tell me how to get IfcDuctSegment in the export
expected_behavior: Classify IfcFlowSegment by property-set names/system type, report counts, explain IFC4 duct/pipe segment classes and IfcExportAs / mapping table options.

prompt: I have an IDS from the client. run it on the ifc and show which required properties are empty, and tell me which ones revit will never export because empty params get dropped
expected_behavior: Validate against the IDS (ifctester), list failed requirements per entity, and explain that empty Revit parameters are not exported by default so the data must be filled.

prompt: dump all property sets on IfcProject and IfcSite. I added a user defined pset in 2027 and cant tell if it made it in
expected_behavior: Read psets on IfcProject and IfcSite, list custom set names/properties, note that 2027 earlier lacked IfcProject in the picker.

prompt: half my elements show no material in solibri. check which products in the ifc have no material association or style
expected_behavior: List products without IfcRelAssociatesMaterial and without surface style, group by class, suggest checking shading colors/material settings in export.

prompt: in 2027 how do I map a project parameter to a custom IFC property now? the new dialog only shows some params, do I still need the PSet txt
expected_behavior: Explain the Manage Property Sets / Property Mapping workflow in Export IFC > Modify Setup, its known limits (parameter picker filtered by entity and data type) and TXT fallback with a sample line.

prompt: revit 2026 wont export ifc to our network drive, says no write access but I can save files there normally. what do I do
expected_behavior: Suggest exporting to a local path, checking for two IFC exporter add-ins, running as admin, and note the known network-location bug fixed in newer exporter builds.

prompt: link ifc hangs forever on this 400mb file and then revit crashes. use open ifc instead? whats the difference
expected_behavior: Explain that Link IFC converts to RVT in the background, recommend Open IFC then save/link RVT, splitting the IFC, reducing dense geometry; note tradeoffs and memory.

prompt: export this model to IFC4 reference view again but keep the same guids as last time. which param holds the guid and are new elements missing it?
expected_behavior: Explain IfcGUID parameter persistence, check elements missing GUID values, note worksharing and linked-model caveats, then (if Revit connected) run the export with the stored GUIDs.

prompt: set IfcExportAs to IfcFurniture on all generic model families with 'sofa' or 'chair' in the family name, then tell me what changed
expected_behavior: Query generic model families by name, set the IfcExportAs type/instance parameter, report modified elements and any skipped, ask confirmation before bulk edit.
